label: §48(e) Cat 1 LIC (DOE/CDFI NMTC, ACS 2016-2020)
source: DOE "IRA Low-Income Community Bonus Credit Program Layers" — Category 1 column is the CDFI CIMS NMTC LIC determination
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy (data.gov-cataloged), aggregating CDFI Fund / CEQ / USDA
vintage: ACS 2016-2020 (CDFI NMTC LIC) · 2023 census tracts · DOE Excel file 2024-09-19
notes: Static published file (not a live API). The Category-1 column `NMTC_2020_pct` is the legally-operative §48(e) Cat 1 determination; a tract is counted LIC when NMTC_2020_pct > 0 (see QUALIFY_MIN_PCT in api/scrapers/_nmtcLic.js). Per-site eligibility is verified at the parcel level. DOE states the spatial data is for geolocation, not a substitute for the official eligibility determination. RE-SOURCE: re-download the '48 Program | Excel tool' from data.nlr.gov/submissions/222 into data/cdfi-lic/, then `node scripts/seed-nmtc-lic.mjs --apply`, then bump review_due. CDFI re-bases the NMTC LIC vintage when a new ACS 5-year lands (watch for an ACS 2020-2024 transition).
